title: Whole alloy accounts constrained by both constituent content and total weight
summary: RAW_UNREVIEWED, NOT SELECTED. Fibonacci Liber abbaci XI.6 supplies a complete variable account of three coin grades, intermediate mixing, ratio choice, scaling, verification and an alternative method. One global content semantics must preserve both total weight and silver content. The source itself gives unequal valid20-pound solutions; these remain explicit rivals instead of being erased by a preferred trace. This is a new quantity/composition hypothesis, not a fixed source-count or decimal-field repair.

design.mechanism: Typed assertions declare grade, weight and constituent amount. Mixing combines extensive weight and silver quantities; grade is their ratio. Scaling changes every component weight by one common factor; a chosen lower-component ratio becomes a persistent constraint rather than a new freely fitted number at every clause. Explanations, comparisons, choices, alternative solutions and checks have distinct semantic functions within a shared variable-length grammar. A program may describe different actual mixtures, provided all co-references and coupled equations agree. No fixed serialized fields or source paragraph length selected.
design.unit: One whole bounded alloy argument including problem, each intermediate mixture and reasoning branch, numerical or verbal quantity expressions, scaling examples and endpoint proof. The complete source subsection begins at printedp152 and ends in upperp154 before De consolamine trium monetarum cum minutiis; all its content classes are inventoried in the dossier.
design.contrast: IDEA000124 and P06 require material identity/conservation but retain unbound endpoints and freely chosen positive masses. A mass-only ledger cannot distinguish this card's quantity-preserving wrong-grade rival. GDT902 excludes a44-equation/eight-block fixed multiplication copy; GDT909 excludes at least3equal-width fixed division steps within whole paragraphs. Their exact primaries were read. None authorizes a new format by changing source counts, and none is reopened here.
design.prediction: Under one global meaning grammar, every reused intermediate grade and all later weights must satisfy weight sum, constituent sum and weighted mean simultaneously. In the source first solution weights1,1,3at grades3,4,6give5pounds/25ounces/grade5. The same weight multiset reassigned3,1,1gives5pounds/19ounces/grade19/5: mass conservation alone passes, the composition claim fails. Conversely, both source solutions (5/2,25/4,45/4) and(2,7,11) satisfy total20and grade5. A correct model must preserve their non-uniqueness unless additional written ratio/method clauses distinguish them.
